_comment_exclude: The whole scripts/ directory, not one file at a time. These are node --experimental-strip-types runners: they must import with explicit .ts extensions, which this config forbids and which cannot be enabled without allowImportingTsExtensions. Listing them individually meant every new script broke `next build` — the build type-checks the project, so a helper that never ships stopped the site from deploying. Excluded as a directory so adding a script cannot do that again.
